bullets.text: AI-Powered Photo Organization - **Microsoft** Photos now uses AI for automatic photo categorization, enhancing user experience and efficiency.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New build 27954 introduces general improvements and fixes for **Windows 11** Insiders.
Enhanced Text Editing in Edge - **Microsoft Edge** 140 introduces highlightsFromPoint() for improved text editing capabilities.
Reimagined Microsoft Marketplace - A unified platform for cloud solutions and AI apps, enhancing customer access and integration.
XCSSET Malware Update - New variant targets **Xcode** projects, enhancing its capabilities for data exfiltration and persistence.
Podman Integration in Visual Studio - **Visual Studio 2026** now supports Podman for enhanced container development workflows.
Agentic AI for Migration - New tools announced to accelerate migration and modernization efforts across organizations.
Microsoft Purview Success - Implementing **Microsoft Purview** led to a 30% reduction in data breach likelihood for organizations.
